scope: Private offline review only. The original policy did not see snapshot state, checker definitions, expected values or score deltas; these fields do not enter SFT prompts or targets. 15 A-fold scene archives only.
method: For every A scene, verify completion marker against the formal manifest and task files against the marker. Verify job order and registered trees against the frozen source scene. Replay each original terminal tree against the saved, frozen API responses and compare every leaf and whole result.

The initial state is the archived .before.json taken after set-current, bulk landing and bulk charging and before window admission. It is not a new live check or the later first-model-request state. Verify the three original preparation writes and grounded, idle, 100% charge on every drone.

Import each initial and terminal JSON via the original Session.from_dict and set-current into an isolated, non-ticking simulator. Evaluate the actual check endpoints via the original controller/check_ui tree. This retains serialized session histories and entity state. All 603 persistent-state terminal leaf truth values equal their frozen observations.

Drone.history_status is reconstructed empty by set-current. This is appropriate at preparation: original set-current reloads every drone, administrative land_all/charge_all only add session-level state history. The simulation may record a passive automatic charge, but none of the 1930 leaves checks charge history, uses a since_timestamp, or depends on a passive charge. No physical commands appeared between consecutive frozen terminal and prepared initial snapshots in A. All first post-snapshot physical commands are no earlier than window open. In contrast, final JSON omits the task transient log. Only the saved actual endpoint responses supply authoritative final scores.

Identify physical commands using new unique command_id values in the after vs before session histories. Across all A tasks, initial command IDs are retained in the final history, both lists have unique keys, and the delta is within this task. Group by actor/action/status. A successful new simulator command identifies a review candidate, not reliable teacher behavior by itself. Check its actual tool call, receipt, requested actor/action/target, and any ordering or duration separately.
